notes: The recorder, driven. Everything about the recording stayed the same; what changed is the page you drive it from. The sound and format switches are on the page itself now, so changing your mind no longer costs a second tab and a reload. After you choose what to share there are three seconds to get back to what you are recording, and the recording tab says what it is doing in its own title and icon, so you can find it again among fifteen. While it runs, a meter beside each sound source shows whether sound is actually arriving - a muted microphone used to read exactly like a working one. The finished recording has an editable name, and renaming it leaves one file in Downloads, under the name that then goes to Drive and into the checklist. Space starts and stops it. A small floating window now shows the clock and a Stop button while you work somewhere else - a window of its own, never anything added to the page you are recording. Drag it onto a second screen once and it opens there every time, out of your recordings.
